currentQualification.purpose: Activate immediately on the first exact leading Ivy result; trust it without final wake confirmation. Recognize alright/all right I am/Im done as whole completion commands.
currentQualification.method: Kokoro fixture through synthetic Web Audio in the actual diagnostic native WebView; real local Whisper, verified Terra, and native speech playback. Separate clean production app startup verified through Windows UI.

automatedVerification.desktopBrowserTests: 29/29 passed on final full run; the initial strengthened half-second test fed too few frames to include activity-onset confirmation, then passed after its fixture included that onset.
automatedVerification.lintTestBuild: Affected desktop, adapter and E2E Nx lint/test/build passed; E2E lint passed again after the frame-fixture correction.
automatedVerification.nativeSmoke: Production embedded WebView shell, styles and versioned IPC passed.

limitations: A single synthetic speech observation, not latency percentiles or physical speech accuracy. The final production app uses the actual microphone; recognition and end-command checks used synthetic audio.
A native diagnostic instrumentation attempt timed out and was discarded; the owned diagnostic was restarted before the recorded passing run.
First-hit trust intentionally accepts an exact prefix even if a later transcript would revise it. Similar words without an Ivy hit and mentions inside dictation do not independently activate.

Whisper inference latency remains; this is not a dedicated acoustic wake detector. Command dispatch still waits for the finalized utterance and recognition input remains gated during thinking/playback.
Private fixtures and detailed receipts remain in ignored artifacts; no user audio is included.

previousPresenceQualification.method: Kokoro WAV fixtures fed through Web Audio in the actual native WebView with real local Whisper, Ivy/Terra and native speech playback. RAF sampled foreground/emblem presence; wrappers observed capture ownership and submission boundaries.
